feeds.title: Hauptstadtmutti
feeds.description: Blog posts cover articles on motherhood, parenting, lifestyle specifically in Berlin community.

feeds.title: Mamalismus
feeds.description: Mamalismus is THE Leipzig Mamablogazin for all women, mothers, and parents. Written by Priska, a 3-time girl mom, author, theologian, freelance editor, and story lover. Get inspiration from the latest ideas, travel tips, deep thoughts, other people, toy trends, and fashion topics.

feeds.title: Kathastrophal
feeds.description: Plus Size Fashion & Lifestyle Blog by Katha from Wiesbaden with many plus size outfits and ideas for DIY, sewing, baking, traveling, marrying & more.

feeds.title: Mama im Spagat
feeds.description: I'm Nadja, a mother of two who struggles between family and work.On my blog, I report about the normal madness between work, family, and all the organizational madness. With me, you will find a lot of tips about smart family management, leisure tips (mainly Bavaria), quick recipes for the whole family, simple craft ideas as well as book and product recommendations that make everyday mom's life easier.

feeds.title: Vegan Mom
feeds.description: I am Anna. With my blog, I want to show that vegan food is a colorful, tasty, healthy, and wholesome form of nutrition and I would like to encourage and offer support to those of you who still shy away from changing your diet.

feeds.title: Mini Menschlein
feeds.description: MiniMenschlein is a blog for families. Here Leonie writes about children's birthdays, special interiors for young and old, children's books, healthy cuisine, and party cakes. I also show simple DIYs that can be done with small children.

feeds.title: Style. Pray. Love.
feeds.description: A fashion, beauty, and lifestyle blogazine for mums. We write about:the beauty of life, the values we want to convey to our children & above all - the love for them.

feeds.title: Isar Mami
feeds.description: I'm Melanie, a two-time 34-year-old working boy mum from Munich. Besides my part-time job, I enjoy spending time with my family, especially outside. I love the mountains, I like to bake and eat for my life and I also love to write about everything beautiful and useful! And no, I am NEVER bored!

feeds.title: Juliet Rome
feeds.description: Juliet Rome inspires a smart, stylish, graceful life. She believes beauty is the heart of contentment and a gift to those we love.

feeds.title: Mum in Berlin
feeds.description: Hi! My name is Paulina. I'm an engineer and a mother of 3 kids. I love travelling and am a big fan of micro-travelling - I love going on short trips and exploring the nearest surroundings. I've set up this page to share this passion with you! You'll find here descriptions and photos of my and my family's little getaways, aimed at informing and (hopefully!) inspiring you to see interesting places (playgrounds, museums, landscapes .. in and out of Berlin.

feeds.title: Decor8 Blog
feeds.description: An expertly curated interior design, trend, decorating, and lifestyle blog featuring stories and products to educate and inspire readers. Decor8 is an influential design blog by founder, author, and stylist Holly Becker.

feeds.title: Around About Munich
feeds.description: Key topics covered are travel, parenting, motherhood, lifetyle and more. Inken is the author behind the blog and a mother herself.

feeds.title: Super Mom
feeds.description: Blog posts cover parenting, motherhood, beauty and fashion, travel, meal and preps, and more. Jette is the author behind the blog and a mom herself.

feeds.title: Mutti so yeah
feeds.description: I'm Mareike and this site is packed with Muddi-Power, lists (my yoga!), DIY ideas, and favorite things that put you in a good mood. You can never have enough of it, especially when your sleep and your nerves are running out.

feeds.title: Berlin Mitte Mom
feeds.description: Berlinmittemom is the place for authentic texts about being a parent, favorite books, colorful lunch boxes, and plasters on children's knees. This is about everyday family life in Berlin's big-city flair, traveling with children, upbringing and education issues, and the good life.

feeds.title: Journelles
feeds.description: Journelles is the largest independent fashion blogazine in Germany and was founded in 2012 by Jessie Weiß. The 34-year-old entrepreneur laid the foundation stone for the fashion blogosphere with the network veteran LesMads in 2007 and has been working as a journalist, presenter and creative director ever since.

feeds.title: Allesinklein
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Petra, mother of two daycare boys and a third grader. This is about family, children, but also about the role as a woman who may not always be a mother. About traveling (also on the doorstep), about what we do all day long. About our home in the area around Munich and what you can experience there (or not).

feeds.title: Fashionblonde
feeds.description: The blog focuses on beauty and fashion, lifestyle, travel, DIYs, and more. Julia is the author behind the blog and a mother herself.

feeds.title: Tagtraeumerin Blog
feeds.description: Hey! My name is Laura, I am 30 years old and live in Leipzig. I've been writing about fashion, homemade things, and everything else that makes me happy on tagtraeumerin.de since 2007.

feeds.title: Susamamma
feeds.description: I am Susanna: mom blogger & lifestyle blogger. Susamamma.de is my treasure chest: packed full of thoughts, experiences, delicacies, products, places, LIFE. I love the finer things in life and I hold onto them tightly. To me. For you. In words and pictures.

feeds.title: Mom Can Do This
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Carolin. Helping moms get more done with less stress, manage time better and blog like a rockstar.

feeds.title: Julies Dresscode
feeds.description: My name is Julie and I've been blogging on my personal fashion and lifestyle blog Julies Dresscode since 2014.

feeds.title: Mamiplatz
feeds.description: I'm Saskia. Here you can find out everything about my everyday jungle. Travel, parenting, motherhood, lifestyle, and more.

feeds.title: Lisa Hahnbück
feeds.description: Lisa Hahnbück is a lifestyle, travel & fashion blog from Düsseldorf, Germany for women who love fashion and the latest trends and must haves of the season.

feeds.title: Oh Wunderbar Blog
feeds.description: We are Tini and Janina. This is a lifestyle and mom blog for women who love the good life. More than fashion, food, travel, and kids. Quite normal and yet so different. Honestly without make-up, but always with a good pinch of humor.

feeds.title: Julia Mosig Blog
feeds.description: We are Andre and Julia Mosig. Content creators and mindfulness trainers. At juliamosig.de, you will find a mixture of everyday life and travel adventures, of fun and seriousness, of lightness and depth - with child and dog.

feeds.title: Littleyears
feeds.description: Little Years has been the digital platform for modern parents since 2013. In the blog, you can find all sorts of stories about having children and everything that is fun about it (and sometimes not). Lifestyle, social debates, feelings of motherhood, product tips, and much more.

feeds.title: Allerliebeanfang
feeds.description: I am Sandra. I write about my life as a young, modern mom & wife. Topics are mom & baby lifestyle, beauty, home life, baby fashion, traveling with baby and many more.

feeds.title: The Salonette Collection Blog
feeds.description: I am Insa. These are my stories, discoveries and inspirations about stylish family life in the big city.
